name: Billing Services Tax 3
definition: Provides for regional taxes on the service.

Number.name: Number
Number.definition: Identification number of the specific region tax used to calculate the tax.

Description.name: Description
Description.definition: Name used to describe the tax (such as the national value added tax).

Rate.name: Rate
Rate.definition: Rate used to calculate the tax.

TotalTaxAmount.name: Total Tax Amount
TotalTaxAmount.definition: Specifies the tax obligation for taxable services within a tax region for a specific tax identifier (such as national value added tax equals 34,00), and expressed in the tax region’s host currency.
